body.purpose: General interface text and list rows.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #0066FF; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 8px 16px; border: none; border-radius: 8px; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; }

components.name: Card
components.css: .ds-card { background: #FFFFFF; border: 0.5px solid #E5E5E5; border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; font-size: 14px; color: #111111; } .ds-card h3 { font-size: 20px; font-weight: 500; margin: 0 0 8px 0; } .ds-card p { color: #888888; margin: 0; }

components.name: Segmented Tab
components.css: .ds-segmented-control { display: inline-flex; background: #F7F7F7; border: 0.5px solid #E5E5E5; border-radius: 8px; padding: 2px; } .ds-segmented-control button { background: transparent; border: none; border-radius: 6px; padding: 4px 12px; font-size: 14px; color: #888888; cursor: pointer; } .ds-segmented-control button.active { background: #FFFFFF; color: #111111; border: 0.5px solid #E5E5E5; }

narrative.overview: A highly functional, data-dense interface inspired by productivity tools like Linear, Notion, and iOS Settings. The aesthetic is strictly flat and utilitarian, prioritizing clarity, information density, and speed over decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Strictly flat design with no shadows or gradients.
Off-white backgrounds with white cards and hairline 0.5px borders.
Utilitarian geometric shapes with 8-12px rounded corners.
A single blue accent used very sparingly.
Compact list rows and segmented tabs.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: The blue accent is used sparingly (≤5% of any screen). Its rarity is the point, signalling only actionable elements or primary data points.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Shadows and gradients are strictly prohibited. Depth is conveyed via structural borders.

dos: Do use segmented tabs for view switching.
Do use outline icons for all iconography.
Do keep list rows compact to show more scrobbles at once.
Do use a 0.5px border for dividing content and framing cards.
donts: Don't use any box-shadows or drop-shadows.
Don't use gradients anywhere in the UI.
Don't use dropdown menus for primary navigation or filtering where segmented tabs could fit.
